steps.q: Does it make a great product or service?

views.text: In October 2023, Equity Mates introduced Impact Minerals as a mining explorer whose main project was the Lake Hope high purity alumina deposit about 500 kilometres east of Perth, positioning the company around HPA rather than traditional battery metals.

episode.title: Uncovered: There's more to a battery than Lithium, introducing HPA - Impact Minerals (ASX: IPT)

steps.q: Will it keep earning above market profits?

views.text: In October 2023, a guest on Equity Mates said long term success would be becoming a dominant player in a small HPA market, which would deliver pricing power and help the business make it through the cycle.

episode.title: Uncovered: There's more to a battery than Lithium, introducing HPA - Impact Minerals (ASX: IPT)

steps.q: Can it reinvest its profits productively?

views.text: In October 2023, a guest on Equity Mates explained the company was rationalising its portfolio to focus on Lake Hope, aiming to release a scoping study and move into production quickly.

episode.title: Uncovered: There's more to a battery than Lithium, introducing HPA - Impact Minerals (ASX: IPT)
